title: Report: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling to miss at least a month with an ankle injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling to miss at least a month with an ankle injury
sources.description: The 49ers lost wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling to an ankle injury on their way to a win over the Rams in Melbourne, Australia on Thursday and it will reportedly be a bit of time before the rookie is able to return to action.
